channel.title: FlamingPiston
channel.description: Honest automotive reviews, practical buying advice, and maintenance guides.

item.title: BMW 7 Series & i7 Facelift: India Sept 11
item.description: BMW launches the facelifted 7 Series and i7 in India on September 11. New Panoramic iDrive, 17.9-inch screen, revised engines. Prices not yet announced.

item.title: Baleno Facelift Sept 5: What’s Confirmed
item.description: Maruti launches the Baleno facelift on September 5. Here is what is actually confirmed, what is still spy-shot guesswork, and what it means for buyers.

item.title: Porsche Cayenne Electric: India Sept 30
item.description: Porsche brings the Cayenne Electric to India on September 30 — 113kWh battery, up to 1,156hp, 642km claimed. Prices have been live since late 2025.

item.title: Brezza Boot Space & Family Practicality
item.description: How much the Brezza's 328-litre boot actually holds, what the rear seat is really like for four adults, and whether it works as a family car.

item.title: Brezza Maintenance Cost: 5-Year Guide
item.description: What five years of Brezza ownership costs: service schedule, typical bills, and the real petrol-vs-CNG and manual-vs-automatic difference.

item.title: Maruti Brezza Pros & Cons: Before You Buy
item.description: What the Brezza genuinely gets right, the trade-offs nobody mentions in the showroom, and who should be looking at something else instead.

item.title: Brezza Safety & Bharat NCAP Explained
item.description: The Brezza's 5-star Bharat NCAP score explained: what 30.41/32 and 43/49 mean, how the test works, and what's standard across the range.

item.title: Brezza Turbo vs 1.5 Petrol: Which Engine?
item.description: Brezza turbo vs 1.5 petrol: the specs side by side, how they actually drive, and why running costs favour the engine you'd expect least.

item.title: Ford Fathom EV Truck Revealed: $28,350, 2027
item.description: Ford names its affordable electric truck the Fathom — starting at $28,350 on a new UEV platform, with preorders opening early 2027. Built in America.

item.title: MG Hector Tomahawk: 517km EV, PHEV Launched
item.description: MG Hector Tomahawk EV launched at ₹19.49 lakh with 517km range, 69.2kWh LFP battery, V2H, and 7 seats. PHEV starts at ₹25.69 lakh with 1,100km total range.

item.title: Slate Truck: $28K EV, No Federal Credit
item.description: Slate Auto's Bezos-backed electric truck starts at $28,000, but the $7,500 federal credit is gone. 150–240 mile range, production late 2026.

item.title: US New Car Prices Hit $49,077 in August 2026
item.description: Average US new car price hits $49,077 in August 2026 as tariff-era discounts thin out. Hybrids are the safe buy; EVs are better value used.

item.title: Audi Q3 India Debut: Price, Specs & Launch
item.description: The third-gen Audi Q3 has debuted in India, launching this festive season with a 204hp 2.0 TFSI petrol and Quattro AWD. Price expected around Rs 60 lakh.

item.title: Kia Sorento India: Hybrid, Diesel & AWD
item.description: Kia Sorento launches in India on September 4 with a 238 PS strong-hybrid, 2.2L diesel, AWD and 3-row seating. Starting price around ₹40 lakh.

item.title: Nexon Camo Edition: ₹9.99L, ADAS & Dashcam
item.description: Tata Nexon Camo Edition launched at ₹9.99 lakh — two exclusive colours, 12.3-inch screen, integrated dashcam and ADAS. Petrol, diesel and CNG.

item.title: 2026 Mercedes S-Class India: ₹2.20 Cr PHEV
item.description: The 2026 Mercedes-Benz S-Class facelift is now in India. It's PHEV-only at ₹2.20–2.38 crore, with 115 km EV range, MBUX Superscreen, and 15 airbags.

item.title: Maruti Brezza CNG Review: Mileage & Cost
item.description: The 2026 Brezza CNG finally gets an underbody tank — no more butchered boot. Here's what that actually means, what it costs, and who should buy it.

item.title: 7 Series vs S-Class vs G90: Which Flagship?
item.description: The S-Class sets the standard. The 7 Series drives better. The G90 costs less and gives more. Which flagship sedan is actually right for you?

item.title: BMW X5 vs Genesis GV80 vs Volvo XC90
item.description: The BMW X5 drives, the Genesis GV80 overdelivers, the Volvo XC90 reassures. Three answers to one question — and which suits you.

item.title: Range Rover Sport vs BMW X5 vs GLE
item.description: The Range Rover Sport costs more than the BMW X5 and Mercedes GLE. Here's whether that premium is actually justified — and which one is right for you.
